driving_fixture.what: 3-minute driving windows (speed, acceleration) derived from the generated sample cars; lets the world generator run without the real VIF-AEGIS / EPA traces

corpus.what: small slices of an electric, a petrol, a diesel and a hybrid car and of the situations that matter (missing signals, protocol variation, faults, stale data, no data)

sample_cars.what: the four-year generated sample cars (electric, petrol, diesel): the ground the answer tests are checked against
sample_cars.make: python tools_build_worlds.py (needs the driving traces or the driving fixture)

legacy_worlds.what: the first generated vehicles and their ground truth (gen_*.db, truth.json), which older tests quote number for number; they cannot be regenerated bit-for-bit without the real driving traces
legacy_worlds.make: restore them from the release data bundle
